response.reason: The kernel performs Kahan (compensated) summation over each row in float32 with fp fusion disabled. For this workload the huge ±2^80 entries cancel exactly (lost term is exactly 0), and every value dropped when adding small/mixed terms to 2^80 is captured exactly in the correction term, so total+correction approximates the exact real row sum (the sum of the small values, ~O(8)) well within the 1e-5 relative tolerance; the input is never modified and output is a finite (4,) float32 tensor.
